acceptance: all elements finite, every NaN poison overwritten, and all three bounds satisfied (compared with <=, so a zero limit demands an exact answer) after every call; scored cases, the native edge cases (two calls each) and the sanitizer subset use the same rule

memory_safety.sanitizer: compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck, PYTORCH_NO_CUDA_MEMORY_CACHING=1, plain allocations, one call per sanitize case

reference.visible_keys_only: each request is de-paged to its first l_b keys; hidden slots, unused pages and unused table entries never reach the reference
